#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
  static string readLine() {
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    return line;
  }

  static void writeLine(string str) {
    cout << str << endl;
  }

  static int readInt() {
    string line = readLine();
    return stoi(line);
  }

  static long readLong() {
    string line = readLine();
    return stoll(line);
  }

  static vector<int> readIntArray() {
    string line = readLine();
    vector<int> arr;
    istringstream iss(line);
    int num;
    while (iss >> num) {
      arr.push_back(num);
    }
    return arr;
  }

  static vector<long> readLongArray() {
    string line = readLine();
    vector<long> arr;
    istringstream iss(line);
    long num;
    while (iss >> num) {
      arr.push_back(num);
    }
    return arr;
  }

  static void writeArray(vector<int> arr) {
    string str;
    for (int num : arr) {
      str += to_string(num) + " ";
    }
    writeLine(str);
  }

  static void writeArray(vector<long> arr) {
    string str;
    for (long num : arr) {
      str += to_string(num) + " ";
    }
    writeLine(str);
  }

  static int gcd(int a, int b) {
    if (b == 0) return a;
    return gcd(b, a % b);
  }

  static long log(long no, long n) {
    long i = 1;
    int cnt = 0;
    long sum = 0;
    while (i < no) {
      sum += i;
      cnt++;
      if (sum == n) break;
      i *= 2;
    }
    if (cnt == 0) {
      cnt = 1;
      sum = 0;
    }
    return cnt;
  }

  static long arrSum(vector<long> arr) {
    long tot = 0;
    for (long num : arr) {
      tot += num;
    }
    return tot;
  }

  static int ord(char b) {
    return b - 'a';
  }

  static int optimSearch(vector<int> cnt, int lower_bound, int pow, int n) {
    int l = lower_bound + 1;
    int h = n;
    int ans = 0;
    while (l <= h) {
      int mid = l + (h - l) / 2;
      if (cnt[mid] - cnt[lower_bound] == pow) return mid;
      else if (cnt[mid] - cnt[lower_bound] < pow) {
        ans = mid;
        l = mid + 1;
      } else {
        h = mid - 1;
      }
    }
    return ans;
  }

  static pair<long, int> ret_ans(vector<int> ans) {
    int size = ans.size();
    int mini = 1000000000 + 1;
    long tit = 0;
    for (int num : ans) {
      tit += num;
      mini = min(mini, num);
    }
    return make_pair(tit - mini, mini);
  }

  static int factorList(map<int, int> maps, int no, int maxK, int req) {
    int i = 1;
    while (i * i <= no) {
      if (no % i == 0) {
        if (i != no / i) {
          maps[no / i]++;
        }
        maps[i]++;
        if (maps[i] == req) maxK = max(maxK, i);
        if (maps[no / i] == req) maxK = max(maxK, no / i);
      }
      i++;
    }
    return maxK;
  }

  static vector<int> getKeys(map<int, int> maps) {
    vector<int> vals;
    for (auto map : maps) {
      vals.push_back(map.first);
    }
    return vals;
  }

  static vector<int> getValues(map<int, int> maps) {
    vector<int> vals;
    for (auto map : maps) {
      vals.push_back(map.second);
    }
    return vals;
  }

  static int getMax(vector<int> arr) {
    int max = arr[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < arr.size(); i++) {
      if (arr[i] > max) max = arr[i];
    }
    return max;
  }

  static int getMin(vector<int> arr) {
    int max = arr[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < arr.size(); i++) {
      if (arr[i] < max) max = arr[i];
    }
    return max;
  }

  static int findBinaryExponentian(int a, int pow, int mod) {
    if (pow == 1) return a;
    else if (pow == 0) return 1;
    else {
      int retVal = findBinaryExponentian(a, pow / 2, mod);
      int val = (pow % 2 == 0) ? 1 : a;
      return (retVal * retVal) % mod * val % mod;
    }
  }

  static int findPow(int a, int b, int mod) {
    if (b == 1) return a % mod;
    else if (b == 0) return 1;
    else {
      int res = findPow(a, b / 2, mod);
      return (res * res) % mod * (b % 2 == 1 ? a : 1) % mod;
    }
  }

  static int bleft(int ele, vector<int> sortedArr) {
    int l = 0;
    int h = sortedArr.size() - 1;
    int ans = -1;
    while (l <= h) {
      int mid = l + (h - l) / 2;
      if (sortedArr[mid] < ele) {
        ans = mid;
        l = mid + 1;
      } else if (sortedArr[mid] >= ele) {
        h = mid - 1;
      }
    }
    return ans;
  }

  static int primeList(int MAXI) {
    vector<int> prime(MAXI + 1);
    set<int> obj;
    for (int i = 2; i <= sqrt(MAXI) + 1; i++) {
      if (prime[i] == 0) {
        obj.insert(i);
        for (int j = i * i; j <= MAXI; j += i) {
          prime[j] = 1;
        }
      }
    }
    for (int i = sqrt(MAXI) + 1; i <= MAXI; i++) {
      if (prime[i] == 0) {
        obj.insert(i);
      }
    }
    return obj.size();
  }

  static vector<int> factorialList(int MAXI, int mod) {
    vector<int> factorial(MAXI + 1);
    factorial[2] = 1;
    for (int i = 3; i < MAXI + 1; i++) {
      factorial[i] = (factorial[i - 1] * i) % mod;
    }
    return factorial;
  }

  static void put(map<int, int> cnt, int key) {
    if (cnt.find(key) != cnt.end()) {
      cnt[key]++;
    } else {
      cnt[key] = 1;
    }
  }

  static int modAdd(int a, int b, int mod) {
    return (a % mod + b % mod) % mod;
  }

  static int modSub(int a, int b, int mod) {
    return (a % mod - b % mod + mod) % mod;
  }

  static int modMul(int a, int b, int mod) {
    return (a % mod * b % mod) % mod;
  }

  static int modDiv(int a, int b, int mod) {
    return modMul(a, findBinaryExponentian(b, mod - 1, mod), mod);
  }

  static void main() {
    string s = readLine();
    int n = s.length();
    if ((s[0] == '0' || s[0] == '_' || s[0] == 'X') && n == 1) {
      writeLine("1");
    } else if (n == 1) {
      writeLine("0");
    } else if (s[0] == '0') {
      writeLine("0");
    } else {
      string digits[] = {"25", "50", "75", "00"};
      string arr1[] = {"__", "_X", "X_", "XX"};
      int way[] = {4, 4, 4, 1};
      way[1] = s[0] == 'X' ? 2 : 4;
      way[2] = s[0] == 'X' ? 3 : 4;
      way[0] = n == 2 ? 3 : way[0];
      way[1] = n == 2 ? 3 : way[1];
      int ways = 0;
      string v = s.substr(n - 2, n);
      for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if (v == digits[i]) ways = 1;
      }
      if (v[0] == '_' || v[0] == 'X') {
        ways = 2;
        if (v[1] == '0' && s[0] == 'X') ways = 1;
      } else if (v[1] == '_' || v[1] == 'X') ways = 1;
      for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if (v == arr1[i]) {
          ways = way[i];
        }
      }
      if (v == "XX" && s[0] == 'X') ways = 0;
      if (v[0] != '2' && v[0] != '5' && v[0] != '7' && v[0] != '0' && v[0] != 'X' && v[0] != '_') ways = 0;
      if (v[1] != '0' && v[1] != '5' && v[1] != 'X' && v[1] != '_') ways = 0;
      bool ok = false;
      long toti = 1;
      for (int i = 0; i < n - 2; i++) {
        if (s[i] == 'X') ok = true;
        if (s[i] == '_') {
          if (i == 0) toti *= 9;
          else toti *= 10;
        }
      }
      if (v[0] != 'X' && v[1] != 'X') {
        if (ok) {
          if (s[0] == 'X') toti *= 9;
          else toti *= 10;
        }
      }
      toti *= ways;
      writeLine(to_string(toti));
    }
  }
};

int main() {
  ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
  cin.tie(NULL);
  Solution::main();
  return 0;
}
